No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. This new habitat-form sheet has NO image input; use the explicit natural/magical form descriptions below, not invented jewelry or clothing. Complete feet/tails/fins/wings, believable anatomy; no fused feet, duplicated tails, extra limbs or costume. Four legs for quadrupeds, two legs/two wings for birds, six legs for insects, correct fish fin plan. No habitat/branches/water/pedestal attached. No rig or animation claimed.
